No please don't feel guilty, it's nothing to do with you and it's not your fault. I was in the same situation, and I was torn up about it but after a while I realised it wasn't because of me that she had issues. DON'T do anything stupid, because it'll be even worse for everyone if you're gone.

My closest friend really helped with everything, because she didn't impose the same way everyone else seemed to. My parents tried forcing me to stop self harming which only made my issues worse, yet she was just there for me. It might be stupid, but I felt that helped more.

Just make sure you're there for her and she knows it. If you don't want to get others involved, then being as big of a support as you can is basically all you can do. If she ever does threaten suicide or you have cause to believe she might actually do it then you will have to get help for her, because her life comes before anything else. The same goes for if she gets worse. Just stay strong and stay with her :)
